stemMarkdown: Evaluate $\dfrac{1}{6 + \sqrt{11}}$ as a decimal. (Round to 6 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Multiply top and bottom by the conjugate $6 - \sqrt{11}$: $\dfrac{6 - \sqrt{11}}{6^2 - 11} = \dfrac{6 - \sqrt{11}}{25} = 0.107335$.
altSolutionMarkdown: Rationalising does not change the value — it just moves the irrational part to the numerator.
